identifiers.identifier_scope: Investigational radiopharmaceutical code/name for a lutetium-177-labeled PSMA-targeting agent.

mechanism_of_action.plain_language: A lutetium-177-labeled PSMA-targeting radiopharmaceutical designed to bind prostate-specific membrane antigen on tumor cells and deliver beta radiation to PSMA-expressing tissue.
mechanism_of_action.molecular_action: Targeted binding to PSMA followed by localized beta-particle irradiation from lutetium-177, causing DNA damage and tumor cell death.
downstream_effects: Internalization of the ligand-receptor complex may occur
Beta-radiation delivery to tumor and nearby cells
mechanism_of_action.selectivity: Intended selectivity for PSMA-expressing tissues; quantitative selectivity data for this specific agent were not identified.

clinical_settings: Investigational use in PSMA-expressing prostate cancer
typical_use.scope: Likely intended for precision radioligand treatment of PSMA-positive prostate cancer; specific labeled or guideline-endorsed use for this exact agent was not identified.
